title: OneNote for Android: Copilot chat pane with page summaries and questions
summary: Hold: the low cost rating conflicts with the briefing's verified add-on licensing requirement and the wiki's cost scale. The rollout, default availability, licensing description and Cloud Policy control are supported; the three documentation links flagged by the pre-check opened successfully.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a new Copilot chat pane in OneNote Mobile on Android.
claims.quote: Microsoft is introducing a new Copilot chat pane in OneNote Mobile (Android) for users licensed with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium).

claims.claim: The Summary feature generates concise summaries of longer OneNote pages.
claims.quote: This update adds a new Summary feature that allows users to generate concise summaries of longer OneNote pages

claims.claim: Users can ask questions about their notes directly within the OneNote mobile app.
claims.quote: as well as ask questions about their notes, directly within the OneNote mobile app.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The pane processes OneNote content the user can already access to generate summaries and answer questions.
claims.quote: Copilot chat processes OneNote content that users already have access to in order to generate summaries and answer questions

claims.claim: The notice says the change alters how existing customer data is processed, stored or accessed.
claims.quote: Does the change alter how existing customer data is processed, stored, or accessed?Yes.

claims.claim: The update introduces generative AI that analyzes note content the user has permission to access.
claims.quote: This update introduces Copilot chat capabilities within OneNote Mobile, allowing generative AI to analyze note content that the user has permission to access.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which the user has at least view permissions.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which individual users have at least view permissions.

claims.claim: Microsoft stores the user's prompt and Copilot response for interactions in apps including OneNote.
claims.quote: When a user interacts with Microsoft Copilot (using apps such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OneNote, Loop, or Whiteboard), we store data about these interactions. The stored data includes the user's prompt and Copilot's response

claims.claim: The record of stored prompt-and-response interactions is the user's Copilot activity history.
claims.quote: We refer to the user's prompt and Copilot's response to that prompt as the "content of interactions" and the record of those interactions is the user's Copilot activity history.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Turning off connected experiences that analyze content makes Copilot unavailable in current OneNote versions on Android.
claims.quote:
If you turn off connected experiences that analyze your content on devices in your organization, Microsoft Copilot features won't be available to your users in the following apps:
- Excel
- OneNote
- Outlook
- PowerPoint
- Word

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The connected-experiences control is broader than this pane and affects Copilot across multiple apps and platforms.
claims.quote: This applies to when you're running the most current version of these apps on Windows, Mac, iOS, or Android devices.

claims.claim: The connected-experiences policy is the one documented lever for removing Copilot availability in OneNote on Android.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote Android Copilot disable turn off admin policy chat pane control. Read privacy, Android privacy and Cloud Policy pages and returned control excerpts; no other control documented as removing this pane was found.

claims.claim: Neither the supplied roadmap nor notice describes the pane changing notes or taking actions.
claims.quote: Searched: read the complete supplied roadmap description and MC1309746 for note editing, writes and actions. They describe summarizing pages and answering questions, without describing changes to notes or autonomous actions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Copilot responses are not guaranteed to be factual.
claims.quote: The responses that generative AI produces aren't guaranteed to be 100% factual.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft suggests informing helpdesk staff and users about Copilot chat and Summary in OneNote mobile.
claims.quote: Consider informing helpdesk staff and users about the availability of Copilot chat and the Summary feature in OneNote mobile.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing model is add-on: Microsoft's overview describes Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) as the full add-on licensed experience.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) is the full add-on licensed experience

claims.claim: Some features of Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) are subject to fair use limits.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) is the full add-on licensed experience (some features are subject to fair use limits)

claims.claim: The notice asks administrators to assign Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) licenses to users who should access the feature.
claims.quote: Ensure that users who should access this feature are assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) license.

claims.claim: The supplied notice names no separate meter or charge for the pane.
claims.quote: Searched: read all of MC1309746, including preparation and compliance sections, for price, meter, charge and billing. The notice specifies Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) licensing but no separate pane charge or meter.

claims.claim: The overview's Usage-based billing capabilities section lists Cowork, Code and Autopilot, not OneNote.
claims.quote:
Microsoft Copilot Cowork
Microsoft Copilot Code (Frontier)
Autopilot (Frontier)

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: A price specific to this Android pane is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "OneNote" "Summary" "Copilot" "price" Android mobile; OneNote Android Copilot pricing limits license summary. Read MC1309746 and Copilot overview; results give general licensing, not a feature-specific price.

claims.claim: A fair-use limit specific to this feature is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "OneNote" "fair use" "limits" "Android"; OneNote Android Copilot summary chat pane mobile licensing price fair use. Read overview and result excerpts; general fair-use language but no limit specific to this Android pane was found.

claims.claim: The policy setting is named Allow the use of connected experiences in Office that analyze content.
claims.quote: Allow the use of connected experiences in Office that analyze content

claims.claim: Cloud Policy is required to apply this privacy setting to Office on Android.
claims.quote: To apply any of these four policy settings for Office on Android devices, you need to use Cloud Policy.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy settings are user-based and apply to users within the policy configuration's scope.
claims.quote: Only user-based policy settings are available. Computer-based policy settings aren't available.

claims.claim: The documented route is Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Customization > Policy Management > Policy configurations > Create > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings.
claims.quote:
Under Customization, select Policy Management.
On the Policy configurations page, select Create.
On the Start with the basics page
On the Choose the scope page
On the Configure Settings page, select the policies that you want to include in the policy configuration.

claims.claim: No API operation to set this Cloud Policy privacy setting is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Cloud Policy service Microsoft 365 API Microsoft Graph policy configurations settings automation; "Cloud Policy" "API" "Office" policy configuration. Read Cloud Policy overview and Management Activity API schema excerpts; no setting-write operation found.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends the Office Apps Administrator role for managing Cloud Policy.
claims.quote: Office Apps Administrator (Recommended) | This role can manage Office apps cloud services, including policy and settings management

claims.claim: The Choose the scope page determines which users a policy configuration applies to.
claims.quote: On the Choose the scope page, determine whether the policy configuration applies to all users, specific groups, or to users who anonymously access documents using Office for the web.

claims.claim: The cost is low because the sources show only license assignment and administrator/helpdesk time.
claims.quote: cost: "low"; licensing.model: "add-on". The standard defines low as "indirect cost only: admin time, communications, training" and medium as "add-on licences for a subset of users, or predictable consumption".
claims.fix: Set cost to "medium" and replace the cost rationale with: "Medium. The pane requires the Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) add-on licence for Android users who should have access. The notice names no separate meter; licence assignment, helpdesk briefing and communication also take staff time."
